name: Weddell seal pup
description:
The Antarctic seal is a large marine mammal that inhabits the icy waters surrounding Antarctica. It has a thick layer of blubber and dense fur that help it survive the extreme cold. These seals are strong and agile swimmers, capable of diving to great depths to find food such as fish, squid, and krill. They spend much of their time in the ocean but come onto the ice to rest, breed, and care for their young. Well adapted to their harsh environment, Antarctic seals play an important role in the polar ecosystem.

This 3D model was realized by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during the Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

name: Esqueleto ballena jorobada joven 🐋
description:
La ballena jorobada (megaptera novaeangliae) es un cetáceo migratorio conocido por sus largas aletas pectorales y espectaculares saltos. Los adultos miden 12-16 m y pesan 25-40 toneladas. Esta especie se alimenta de krill y peces usando técnicas como redes de burbujas. Cada año migra desde aguas polares a zonas tropicales como el Pacífico colombiano (julio-noviembre), donde los juveniles suelen acercarse a la costa. En la exhibición permanente de biología  se conserva el esqueleto de un ejemplar juvenil de aproximadamente 18 metros, casi completo; aunque carece del coxis una pequeña estructura vestigial que recuerda su ascendencia mamífera y terrestre, permite admirar su colosal anatomía y comprender mejor su adaptación a la vida marina. 

Modelo 3D esqueleto de ballena jorobada joven, exhibición biológica de la Universidad del Valle,
Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia.

name: La Grosse Bourre (français)
description:
Total panic on Rue de la Boulangerie!
Just an ordinary Tuesday morning in Paris... until two bikers decide to turn the street into a Grand Prix circuit. 🏁
At the handlebars: a tiger in a racing suit, closely pursued by a fox who seems to have forgotten he’s a fox. And to complicate matters, a lion is acting as co-pilot... because, apparently, a seatbelt was just too conventional. 😂
Meanwhile, Parisians watch the spectacle from the sidewalks:
— "Help!"
— "But it’s aperitif time!"
— "Did anyone think to call the police?"
— "No, but the bakery is still open!"
A 2CV bravely tries to survive the chaos; the motorbikes are smoking, flames are shooting out, and even the pigeons have asked to relocate to a different neighborhood.
The most worrying part?
The sign says "Street Café"...
With this crew, you realize the coffee comes with comprehensive insurance and—most likely—a fire extinguisher. ☕🔥🤣

name: Applike
description:
Small Roman appliqué in the form of a lion, 3.6 cm high. The animal is rendered in a compact and strongly modelled style. The head dominates the composition, with a prominent muzzle, open mouth and small projecting ears. The mane is indicated by irregular raised strands and incised details. Below the head, the body is represented in a simplified, somewhat schematic manner, with the limbs only partly defined.

The expressive but abbreviated modelling is characteristic of small Roman decorative fittings. Such lion-shaped appliqués may have been attached to boxes, furniture, vessels or other objects. In Roman imagery, the lion was a common symbol associated with strength, power and protection. The original function cannot be determined more precisely without information about the reverse and any surviving attachment device. Bronze; H 3,6 cm.

name: ARACHNEIA
description:
ARACHNEIA – personal creature design project
Arachneia was born from the idea of a being caught between worlds. Part human, part arachnid, shaped by organic metal and bioluminescent veins. Her design plays with contrasts: soft deep-sea tones against sharp chrome limbs, cosmic textures against smooth anatomy.
I wanted her to feel like a guardian from a forgotten dimension something beautiful, dangerous, and strangely weightless. The carapace carries hints of decay, while the thread-like structures around her act more like energy than silk. Every element is meant to show that tension between elegance and threat, evolution and machinery.
This project let me push my sculpting, texturing, and lighting into a more surreal direction, blending organic forms with biomech silhouettes.

name: Brain of the Tiger Shark
description: Belonging to the order **Carcharhiniformes** (ground sharks) and the family **Galeocerdonidae** (tiger sharks), *Galeocerdo cuvier* (Péron & Lesueur, 1822) is a large, solitary predator found in tropical and subtropical waters, especially around islands and coastal areas. It gets its name from the dark vertical stripes on its body, resembling a tiger’s pattern. This fish is an opportunistic carnivore, consuming a wide range of prey, earning it the nickname "garbage can of the sea" and they can reach up to 7.5 meters in length and weigh over 3,000 kg. Though typically found in shallow waters, they can dive to depths of 350 meters and occasionally venture into the open ocean. This species is ovoviviparous, giving birth to up to 80 pups per litter. It has highly developed senses, including an acute sense of smell and electroreception. Despite its ecological importance, the tiger shark faces significant threats from overfishing, habitat loss, and the shark fin trade.

name: Dugong (scale model)
description:
3D scan of the scale model (22 cm) of a dugong (*Dugong dugon*). 

This resin model was created by [Naturaliter Srl](https://www.naturaliter.com/) for the permanent exhibition Not Only Cetaceans. Complementing the exhibition dedicated to marine mammals, this display focuses on animals that have adapted to life in the water through evolutionary pathways different from those of dolphins and whales. The exhibition features sirenians (dugongs and manatees), pinnipeds (sea lions, seals, and walruses), and the polar bear. On display are complete skeletons and skulls from the Museum’s historical collections, as well as scale and life-size models and casts of both extant and extinct species. The scale models were specifically designed to be tactile, enabling visually impaired and blind people, to explore and understand the shapes and proportions of these animals and their fossil ancestors.

Specimen: Dugong, *Dugong dugon* (Müller, 1776)

Scanned and edited by Simone Farina

name: Bison
description:
A bison  is a large bovine in the genus Bison
The American and eropean bison are among the largest surviving terrestrial animals in North America and Europe. They are typical artiodactyl (cloven hooved) ungulates, and are similar in appearance to other bovines. They are broad and muscular with shaggy coats of long hair. Adults grow up to 2 metres  in height and 3.5 m  in length for American bison
Bison are nomadic grazers and travel in herds. The bulls leave the herds of females at two or three years of age, and join a herd of males, which usually are smaller than female herds. 

Bison were a significant resource for Indigenous peoples of North America for food and raw materials until near extinction in the late 19th century.

Owing to their size, bison have few predators. Five exceptions are humans, grey wolves, cougars, grizzly bears, and coyotes. Wolves generally take down a bison while in a pack, .Grizzly bears also consume bison, often by driving off the pack and consuming the wolves' kill.

name: Ashen Blight Queen
description:
At the heart of every *Beetle Rubigenum* Colony is the Queen. Almost spider-like in appearance, the Queen's sole purpose is to manage the hive and birth new workers and/or soldiers. 

The *Ashen Blight Queen* is an extremely toxic variant living within it's hive, most often located inside volcanoes, active or inactive. However - unlike it's sister variant, the Fireborne Blight Queen - this one has evolved to make greater use of it's sulfuric surroundings rather than the firey heat itself. When attacked or threatened, it will emit thick clouds of gas (composed mainly of sulfur dioxide) as a defense mechanism, oftentimes filling it's entire chamber with the fumes.

**Other Things to Note:** *Do not engage without wearing a face covering.*

This asset contains 13 animations including Idle, Combat, and Walk animations, as well as two special animations specific to this variant.
(**Spray Fumes, Fume Sweep Attack**)

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer.

name: the Muru / el muru (made in paint 3d)
description:
In the oral traditions of Chile’s coastal regions, particularly among Mapuche communities, there exists a long-whispered legend of ghostly beings that walk the shores before and during catastrophes. These entities had no formal name for centuries - only described in fragments and murmurs passed from survivor to survivor.

It wasn’t until the 27F Earthquake in 2010 that a term gained traction: “Muru”, a word meaning complaint or warning in Mapudungun. Survivors, particularly in Talcahuano, Dichato, and Curanilahue, began using this term to refer to the strange, faceless entities seen walking in the waves before the tsunami struck.

name: Dimorphodon
description:
**game: Carnivores 1 / 2**
Dimorphodon is an ambient animal in Carnivores, Carnivores 2, and Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter.

**reality**

Dimorphodon (from the Greek di, "two," morphe, "form," and odon, "tooth"; "two-formed teeth") is a genus of rhamphorhynchoid pterosaurs from the Early Jurassic, 195 to 190 million years ago. It was named by paleontologist Richard Owen in 1859.

Dimorphodon had a wingspan of approximately 1.4 m and a length of 1 m, including the tail. It had a large, bulky skull, the weight of which was reduced by the presence of large cavities separated by thin bony walls. This structure, reminiscent of the arches of a bridge, led Owen to assert that no other vertebrate had achieved such weight efficiency in its skeletal structure.

description: Incrustada en la fachada oeste de la Mezquita-Catedral de Córdoba, cerca de la calle Torrijos y bajo la Puerta del Sabat, se encuentra la "Estrella de los Deseos", un popular punto de interés que, según la leyenda local, concede un anhelo a quien frote su superficie con el corazón sincero. Aunque el folclore la envuelve en magia, la ciencia revela que se trata en realidad del resto fosilizado de un Clypeaster, un tipo de erizo de mar prehistórico que habitó la región durante el Mioceno. Su presencia en el templo es el resultado natural del uso de piedra calcarenita extraída de canteras locales en la Sierra de Córdoba, un material que solía albergar abundante vida marina prehistórica y que hoy adorna los muros históricos de la ciudad. LA uses them a lot so it wouldn't be right without them. I'm not sure why, but I love LA, will never be sure why. name: Los catorce apóstoles de Jorge Oteiza, Arantzazu
description:
El Friso de los Apóstoles: Es el elemento más destacado. Consta de catorce figuras de Apóstoles (no doce) alineadas a lo largo del friso, talladas en piedra caliza gris de Markina.

El Vacío: La clave de su significado es el hueco interior que el artista deja en las figuras. Oteiza buscaba representar la idea de que el apóstol (y el cristiano) debe "vaciarse de sí mismo" para poder llenarse de Dios y entregarse a los demás.

Los 14 Apóstoles: Los dos apóstoles de los extremos miran hacia el centro, simbolizando a los nuevos cristianos que se unen a la comunidad por la predicación, aumentando el número de creyentes.

La Piedad: Ubicada en la parte superior del friso, representa a Cristo muerto en los brazos de la Virgen.

Al igual que los apóstoles, las figuras de la Piedad también presentan el vacío en la zona del pecho, especialmente en la Virgen, simbolizando el dolor de la pérdida.

name: Cabaña de Culrueba
description:
Model 3D de la Cabaña de Culrueba, un magnífic exemple de l'arquitectura vernacla i tradicional del paisatge aragonès.

Context Històric i Cultural
Aquest tipus de construccions rurals estan estretament lligades a la història agrícola i ramadera d'Aragó. Històricament, aquestes cabanyes (sovint erigides mitjançant la tècnica mil·lenària de la pedra en sec) eren vitals per a la supervivència rural. Servien com a refugi temporal per als pastors durant les llargues jornades de transhumància, protegint-los de les inclemències del temps, i com a espai per emmagatzemar eines. Aquestes estructures reflecteixen una època on l'aprofitament dels recursos naturals locals era essencial, integrant-se harmònicament en l'entorn natural.

Detalls Tècnics
Aquest model busca digitalitzar i preservar el patrimoni arquitectònic mitjançant fotogrametria d'alta resolució:

Captura d'imatges: Dron DJI Mini 4 Pro.
